name: rge-accounting-monorepo
description: Acme Cost Accounting & PayMongo Orchestrator Polyglot Monorepo

scripts.build: cd Frontend && npm install --include=dev && npm run build
scripts.build:dotnet: node -e "const { execSync } = require('child_process'); try { execSync('dotnet publish Backend/src/Host/Rge.Accounting.Host/Rge.Accounting.Host.csproj -c Release -o Backend/publish', { stdio: 'inherit' }); } catch (e) { console.log('Notice: dotnet publish skipped in node build phase: ' + e.message); }"
scripts.heroku-postbuild: npm run build && npm run build:dotnet
